AI Stock Forecasts : SharePreds is your ultimate guide to navigating the complexities of the financial markets. Our innovative app provides cutting-edge stock simulator investing tips by leveraging powerful Machine Learning (ML) algorithms to deliver short-term stock price change predictions. Whether you're a day trader or a long-term investor, our platform is designed to give you a competitive edge. Experience the benefit of making informed decisions and boost your potential for profit.

AI-Powered Stock Trading Predictions:

Unlock the power of AI for your stock trading journey. Our state-of-the-art algorithms generate daily prediction insights for thousands of stocks across American markets. This isn't just another stock game; it's a sophisticated tool designed for serious traders. Each day, our system provides a fresh forecast, indicating the probability of a price increase for each stock. You can analyze how AI predictions have trended over the past week, giving you a clearer picture of what to expect. This is perfect for developing robust swing trading strategies and making a confident buy call. With AI Stock Forecasts : SharePreds, you get more than data; you get actionable intelligence.

Track Stock Trading Portfolio Simulation:

See our AI in action with a fully transparent, simulated stock trading portfolio. Our app showcases a portfolio built from its own top-rated stock signals, demonstrating how these picks perform over time. This powerful tool automatically tracks the portfolio's performance, registering profit and losses based on algorithmically defined stop-loss and sell targets. You can witness how our swing trading strategies navigate the live market, providing you with one of the most practical stock simulator investing tips available: observing a disciplined, AI-driven strategy from start to finish.

Explore Penny Stocks Portfolio Simulation:

AI Stock Forecasts : SharePreds helps you understand this volatile space by showcasing a dedicated penny (pennie) stock simulation. Our app builds and tracks a portfolio of high-potential penny stocks, showing you exactly how our AI's prediction models perform. This gives you invaluable insight into potential breakouts and helps you make a smarter call, using our stock simulator investing tips to explore this exciting market niche with greater confidence.

Algorithmic trading is huge and such tools enabling algorithmic trading appear to play a major role for enterprises being active in this domain. But for individuals, assuming that you don’t have millions to invest in such tools, you will either develop your own solutions or live without a solution.

It is an extremely challenging area. I developed my own solution by using Neural Networks, and even made it available in a mobile app.

Apple App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/se/app/investing-stock-market/id1602383978?l=en&platform=iphone

Google Play Store:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.loheden.investing_stock_market&hl=en&gl=US

Here is what it does in a nutshell:

- It predicts whether the price of a given common stock will go up or down in the coming month.

- Given predictions are probabilistic. If the prediction is above 50%, it indicates that the price of the stock is expected to go up, otherwise a price decrease is predicted.

- As the prediction gets closer to 100% (or 0%), it indicates a stronger algorithmic expectation on a price increase (or decrease).

- Stocks with highest algorithmic price increase likelihood are short listed in 2 groups: One for Penny Stocks, and one for the Non-Penny Stocks. (Penny stocks happen to be a lot more volatile and some people may prefer to focus on just that ones instead.) For these short listed stocks, beside Buy Target, Sell Target and Stop Loss values are shared as well based on recent volatility of each …
